subject: Welcome to AIWA, set your password
preheader: Your account is ready with {{credits}} credits. One step left: set your password.
heroAlt: Sunrise over the hills, with an AIWA prompt: Ask AIWA to build a CRM for my sales team

blocks.html: Your account is ready, it comes with {{credits}} credits, enough to take an idea from a plain-English prompt to a working full-stack app: designed frontend, working backend, its own database, sign-in, and one-click publishing to a live URL.
One step left: set your password and start building.
